sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Fishing Gear is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good day, mercenary. My name is Peacekeeper, and I was referred to you by Skier. Let us not waste time and get straight to business. I need to deliver certain equipment to certain people. I am going to provide you with everything required. Your task is to leave the goods in a designated location. On the coast, next to one of the... what is the Russian word?.. Ah! Breakwaters. There is a boat there. Leave everything inside."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the boat hidden next to the breakwater on Shoreline
- Stash the MF-UNTAR body armor in the boat
- Stash the multitool in the boat

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
- 1,100 Dollars
  - 1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
"My contacts received everything they needed. Good job, will be glad to work with you more, mercenary."

sections.heading: Initial Equipment
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Notes |
| MF-UNTAR body armor | 1 | Needs to be placed at the secret spot |
| Leatherman Multitool | 1 | Needs to be placed at the secret spot |

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to stash the 2 specified items in a rowboat at the beach near the gas station on Shoreline. After accepting the quest you will be sent a MF-UNTAR body armor and a Leatherman Multitool via in-game mail. The Leatherman Multitool is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot. Each item takes 10 seconds to stash.
